text: I would like to request an update and presentation from the Parks & Recreation division on the Barbara Hall Park Revitalization eff orts and for them to receive feedback from the 2SLGBTQ Advisory Committee. Barbara Hall Park, located in Toronto's Church-Wellesley Village, is undergoing revitalization eff orts with a critical focus on preserving, centering, and enhancing of the AIDS Memorial and Trans Memorial — two sites of profound signifi cance to the 2SLGBTQ+ community.
Due to lack of quorum, the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee did not consider this item.
